answer_4.quote: We check the annotations of 'QoA' by extracting 100 pairs of dialogues to conduct pairwise comparison ... This results in an agreement rate of 81% between human judgement and LLM's judgement ... one of the authors inspected 100 utterances and found that the accuracy ranged between 86%-100% across individual features
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators (authors) inspected a sample of LLM‑generated feature annotations for correctness and computed accuracy/agreement rates.
